newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares inch up on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares inch up on selective buying.

text.p: Delhi shares closed a shade higher on Tuesday on heavy buying in select blue chip stocks, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index closed 1.81 points higher at 867.30.
"Activity was confined only to a few counters," said Manoj Mundra of brokers Manasi Consultant.
Brokers said cement maker ACC led the rally following strong buying by foreign institutonal investors and speculators. It closed 87.90 rupees higher at 1,321.
However, TELCO bucked the trend and closed 5.85 rupees lower at 459.50 on profit-taking, brokers said.
